```{r}
# ==========================================
# KOMPLET NYT ANALYSESCRIPT: BINÆR ENTROPI & SDT
# ==========================================
library(tidyverse)

# 1. INDLÆSNING & BINARISERING
mappe_sti <- "/Users/chris/Library/CloudStorage/GoogleDrive-christoffer.andersen.privat@gmail.com/Andre computere/Christoffers Mac/Google Drev/Uni/4Semester/EM3/Eksperiment/Data"
filer <- list.files(path = mappe_sti, pattern = "\\.csv$", full.names = TRUE)

df_clean <- filer %>% 
  map_dfr(read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  mutate(
    # Binarisering: Alle deviants (uanset type) bliver 1, Standard bliver 0
    binary_state = ifelse(state == "Standard", 0, 1),
    # Kategorisering af faser
    phase = case_when(
      block_num <= 12 ~ "1 Deviant (Simple)",
      block_num > 12  ~ "3 Deviants (Mixed)",
      TRUE            ~ "Middle"
    ),
    block_type = ifelse(as.logical(toupper(dynamic)), "Dynamic", "Static")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(response), phase != "Middle")

df_clean <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Vi tjekker nu efter "ss" i stedet for "Standard"
    binary_state = ifelse(state == "ss", 0, 1)
  )


# 2. ENTROPI FUNKTIONER
calc_running_entropy <- function(x) {
  sapply(1:length(x), function(i) {
    current_seq <- x[1:i]
    p <- table(current_seq) / length(current_seq)
    p <- p[p > 0]
    return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
  })
}

# 3. BEREGNING AF LØBENDE ENTROPI & KÆDER
threshold <- 1

analysis_results <- df_clean %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num) %>%
  arrange(trial, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    local_entropy = calc_running_entropy(binary_state),
    is_above = local_entropy > threshold
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# 4. KÆDELÆNGDE & AREAL ANALYSE
entropy_metrics <- analysis_results %>%
  group_by(phase, block_type, participant_id, block_num) %>%
  summarise(
    area_above = sum(pmax(0, local_entropy - threshold), na.rm = TRUE),
    area_below = sum(pmax(0, threshold - local_entropy), na.rm = TRUE),
    # Beregn gennemsnitlig kædelængde
    avg_chain_above = {
      runs <- rle(na.omit(is_above))
      if(length(runs$lengths[runs$values]) == 0) 0 else mean(runs$lengths[runs$values])
    },
    avg_chain_below = {
      runs <- rle(na.omit(!is_above))
      if(length(runs$lengths[runs$values]) == 0) 0 else mean(runs$lengths[runs$values])
    },
    accuracy = mean(as.logical(toupper(correct))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 5. STATISTISK SAMMENLIGNING (TWO-WAY ANOVA)
# Tester om korrekthed påvirkes af fase (1 vs 3 deviants) og blok-type (Static/Dynamic)
# Opdateret model til Repeated Measures ANOVA
model_acc <- aov(accuracy ~ phase * block_type + Error(participant_id/(phase*block_type)), data = entropy_metrics)


# 6. VISUALISERING: KORREKTHED VS. ENTROPISK AREAL
ggplot(entropy_metrics, aes(x = phase, y = accuracy, fill = block_type)) +
  geom_boxplot(alpha = 0.7) +
  facet_wrap(~block_type) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(title = "Korrekthed pr. fase (Binær Model)", 
       subtitle = "Sammenligner diskriminationsevne når entropi-grundlaget er ens",
       y = "Accuracy (%)", x = "Fase") +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Funktion til at udregne Shannon Entropi (Statisk)
calc_entropy <- function(x) {
  p <- table(x) / length(x)
  p <- p[p > 0] # Fjern 0 for at undgå log2(0) fejl
  return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
}

# Funktion til at udregne løbende (kumulativ) entropi pr. trial
calc_running_entropy <- function(x) {
  sapply(1:length(x), function(i) {
    current_seq <- x[1:i]
    current_seq <- current_seq[!is.na(current_seq)] 
    if(length(current_seq) == 0) return(NA)
    
    p <- table(current_seq) / length(current_seq)
    p <- p[p > 0]
    return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
  })
}
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# MONTE CARLO SIMULERING AF BAYESIANSK ENTROPI (Pilot)
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)

# --- 1. Parametre ---
N_trials <- 1440
n_simulations <- 1000

# --- 2. Generator-funktioner (Oversat direkte fra dit PsychoPy script) ---

# Statisk Generator
generate_static <- function(n) {
  seq <- numeric(n)
  current <- 0 # 0 = ss (Standard), 1 = Deviant
  for(i in 1:n) {
    if(current == 0) {
      p_change <- 0.35 # 65% chance for at blive, 35% for afviger
    } else {
      p_change <- 0.90 # 90% chance for at returnere til ss
    }
    
    change <- rbinom(1, 1, p_change)
    current <- ifelse(change == 1, 1 - current, current)
    seq[i] <- current
  }
  return(seq)
}

# Dynamisk Generator (Med Streak-logik)
generate_dynamic <- function(n) {
  seq <- numeric(n)
  current <- 0
  streak <- 0
  for(i in 1:n) {
    streak <- streak + 1
    if(current == 0) {
      change_probs <- c(0.15, 0.25, 0.45, 0.80)
      idx <- min(streak, 4)
      p_change <- change_probs[idx]
    } else {
      change_probs <- c(0.85, 0.99)
      idx <- min(streak, 2)
      p_change <- change_probs[idx]
    }
    
    change <- rbinom(1, 1, p_change)
    next_state <- ifelse(change == 1, 1 - current, current)
    seq[i] <- next_state
    
    if(next_state != current) {
      streak <- 0 # Streak nulstilles ved skift
    }
    current <- next_state
  }
  return(seq)
}

# --- 3. Bayesiansk Opdatering & Entropi-funktion ---
# Denne funktion udregner den løbende entropi, som hjernen "oplever" trial-for-trial.
calc_mean_bayesian_entropy <- function(seq) {
  t <- 1:length(seq)
  cum_dev <- cumsum(seq) # Hvor mange deviants har vi set indtil nu?
  
  # Bayesian Updating (Beta-Binomial Conjugate)
  # Vi starter med en flad prior Beta(1,1).
  # Den forventede sandsynlighed p er (hits + alpha) / (total + alpha + beta)
  p_bayes <- (cum_dev + 1) / (t + 2) 
  
  # Undgå log2 af absolut 0 eller 1
  p_bayes <- pmax(pmin(p_bayes, 0.9999), 0.0001)
  
  # Shannon Entropi: H(p) = -p*log2(p) - (1-p)*log2(1-p)
  running_entropy <- - (p_bayes * log2(p_bayes) + (1 - p_bayes) * log2(1 - p_bayes))
  
  # Returner gennemsnittet for blokken
  return(mean(running_entropy))
}

# --- 4. Kør Monte Carlo Simuleringen ---
# (Dette tager et par sekunder, da den genererer og analyserer 20.000 blokke)
set.seed(42) # For reproducerbarhed
static_entropies <- replicate(n_simulations, calc_mean_bayesian_entropy(generate_static(N_trials)))
dynamic_entropies <- replicate(n_simulations, calc_mean_bayesian_entropy(generate_dynamic(N_trials)))

# --- 5. Forbered Data og Beregn Statistik ---
sim_data <- tibble(
  Entropy = c(static_entropies, dynamic_entropies),
  Block_Type = factor(rep(c("Static", "Dynamic"), each = n_simulations))
)

mean_static <- mean(static_entropies)
sd_static <- sd(static_entropies)
mean_dynamic <- mean(dynamic_entropies)
sd_dynamic <- sd(dynamic_entropies)

# --- Beregn 95% Kvantil-intervaller ---
ci_static <- quantile(static_entropies, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
ci_dynamic <- quantile(dynamic_entropies, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

print("--- 95% INTERVALLER (Kvantiler) ---")
cat("Static 95% CI: [", ci_static[1], "; ", ci_static[2], "]\n")
cat("Dynamic 95% CI: [", ci_dynamic[1], "; ", ci_dynamic[2], "]\n")

```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# MONTE CARLO SIMULERING AF BAYESIANSK ENTROPI (Main)
# ==============================================================================
library(tidyverse)

# --- 1. Parametre ---
N_trials <- 600
n_simulations <- 1000

# --- 2. Generator-funktioner (Oversat direkte fra dit PsychoPy script) ---

# Statisk Generator
generate_static <- function(n) {
  seq <- numeric(n)
  current <- 0 # 0 = ss (Standard), 1 = Deviant
  for(i in 1:n) {
    if(current == 0) {
      p_change <- 0.15 #
    } else {
      p_change <- 0.85 #
    }
    
    change <- rbinom(1, 1, p_change)
    current <- ifelse(change == 1, 1 - current, current)
    seq[i] <- current
  }
  return(seq)
}

# Dynamisk Generator (Med Streak-logik)
generate_dynamic <- function(n) {
  # Allokerer en vektor med 0'er af længden n
  seq <- numeric(n)
  
  # Tæller hvor mange standarder vi har haft i træk
  run_length <- 0 
  
  for(i in 1:n) {
    # Udregn sandsynligheden for en afviger baseret på 'run_length'
    if (run_length < 3) {
      p_deviant <- 0.00
    } else if (run_length == 3) {
      p_deviant <- 0.10
    } else if (run_length == 4) {
      p_deviant <- 0.15
    } else if (run_length == 5) {
      p_deviant <- 0.25
    } else if (run_length == 6) {
      p_deviant <- 0.50
    } else {
      p_deviant <- 1.00 # Efter 7 standarder SKAL den komme
    }
    
    # Kast "terningen" ud fra den nye sandsynlighed
    change <- rbinom(1, 1, p_deviant)
    
    # 1 betyder, at der udløses en afviger
    if (change == 1) {
      seq[i] <- 1           # 1 repræsenterer 'deviant'
      run_length <- 0       # Nulstil tælleren, da vi netop har haft en afviger
    } else {
      seq[i] <- 0           # 0 repræsenterer 'standard'
      run_length <- run_length + 1 # Tæl en ekstra standard i træk
    }
  }
  
  return(seq)
}

# --- 3. Bayesiansk Opdatering & Entropi-funktion ---
# Denne funktion udregner den løbende entropi, som hjernen "oplever" trial-for-trial.
calc_mean_bayesian_entropy <- function(seq) {
  t <- 1:length(seq)
  cum_dev <- cumsum(seq) # Hvor mange deviants har vi set indtil nu?
  
  # Bayesian Updating (Beta-Binomial Conjugate)
  # Vi starter med en flad prior Beta(1,1).
  # Den forventede sandsynlighed p er (hits + alpha) / (total + alpha + beta)
  p_bayes <- (cum_dev + 1) / (t + 2) 
  
  # Undgå log2 af absolut 0 eller 1
  p_bayes <- pmax(pmin(p_bayes, 0.9999), 0.0001)
  
  # Shannon Entropi: H(p) = -p*log2(p) - (1-p)*log2(1-p)
  running_entropy <- - (p_bayes * log2(p_bayes) + (1 - p_bayes) * log2(1 - p_bayes))
  
  # Returner gennemsnittet for blokken
  return(mean(running_entropy))
}

# --- 4. Kør Monte Carlo Simuleringen ---
# (Dette tager et par sekunder, da den genererer og analyserer 20.000 blokke)
set.seed(42) # For reproducerbarhed
static_entropies <- replicate(n_simulations, calc_mean_bayesian_entropy(generate_static(N_trials)))
dynamic_entropies <- replicate(n_simulations, calc_mean_bayesian_entropy(generate_dynamic(N_trials)))

# --- 5. Forbered Data og Beregn Statistik ---
sim_data <- tibble(
  Entropy = c(static_entropies, dynamic_entropies),
  Block_Type = factor(rep(c("Static", "Dynamic"), each = n_simulations))
)

mean_static <- mean(static_entropies)
sd_static <- sd(static_entropies)
mean_dynamic <- mean(dynamic_entropies)
sd_dynamic <- sd(dynamic_entropies)

# --- Beregn 95% Kvantil-intervaller ---
ci_static <- quantile(static_entropies, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))
ci_dynamic <- quantile(dynamic_entropies, probs = c(0.025, 0.975))

print("--- 95% INTERVALLER (Kvantiler) ---")
cat("Static 95% CI: [", ci_static[1], "; ", ci_static[2], "]\n")
cat("Dynamic 95% CI: [", ci_dynamic[1], "; ", ci_dynamic[2], "]\n")

```



```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# ANALYSE AF ENTROPI: STIMULUS VS. RESPONS (STATISK VS. DYNAMISK)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Funktion til at beregne statisk (global) Shannon Entropi
# Denne funktion udregner entropien af en hel blok (eller sekvens) i bits.
calc_global_entropy <- function(x) {
  # Fjern NA-værdier
  x <- x[!is.na(x)]
  if(length(x) == 0) return(NA)
  
  # Beregn sandsynligheder for hver unik hændelse
  p <- table(x) / length(x)
  p <- p[p > 0] # Fjern 0-sandsynligheder (undgår log2(0) = -Inf)
  
  # Returner Shannon entropien i bits (-sum(p * log2(p)))
  return(-sum(p * log2(p)))
}

# 2. Beregn entropi pr. blok, pr. deltager
# Her kigger vi på, hvor uforudsigelig selve stimulus-strømmen (binary_state) var
# vs. hvor uforudsigelige forsøgspersonens faktiske tryk (response) var.
entropy_comparison <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Binariser stimulus: 0 for Standard, 1 for Deviant
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    block_type = factor(block_type, levels = c("Static", "Dynamic"))
  ) %>%
  # Gruppér for hver specifik blok
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  summarise(
    # Udregn den faktiske stimulus-entropi i denne blok
    stim_entropy = calc_global_entropy(binary_state),
    # Udregn entropien i deltagernes egne gæt
    resp_entropy = calc_global_entropy(response),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 3. Beregn Gennemsnit (Mean) og Spredning (SD) på tværs af deltagerne
summary_entropy_stats <- entropy_comparison %>%
  group_by(block_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_stim_entropy = mean(stim_entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_stim_entropy = sd(stim_entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    
    mean_resp_entropy = mean(resp_entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_resp_entropy = sd(resp_entropy, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print("--- GENNEMSNITLIG ENTROPI (BITS) ---")
print(summary_entropy_stats)

# ==============================================================================
# STATISTISK TEST (ANOVA)
# ==============================================================================

# 4. Omstrukturering af data til "Long format" for at kunne lave et samlet plot og test
entropy_long <- entropy_comparison %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(stim_entropy, resp_entropy),
    names_to = "entropy_source",
    values_to = "entropy_value"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    entropy_source = factor(ifelse(entropy_source == "stim_entropy", "Stimulus (Reality)", "Response (Prediction)"))
  )

# 5. Two-Way Mixed ANOVA
# Vi tester: Er der en interaktion mellem, om vi kigger på stimulus/respons, og om blokken er statisk/dynamisk?
# Vi inkluderer (1|participant_id) for at tage højde for, at samme person har lavet flere blokke.
print("--- ANOVA: EFFEKT AF KILDE (STIM/RESP) OG BLOKTYPE (STAT/DYN) ---")
model_entropy <- aov(entropy_value ~ block_type * entropy_source + Error(participant_id/(block_type*entropy_source)), data = entropy_long)
summary(model_entropy)

# 6. Parvise t-tests (Hvor præcist er der en signifikant forskel?)
# Test A: Er respons-entropien forskellig fra stimulus-entropien i Statisk?
# Test B: Er respons-entropien forskellig fra stimulus-entropien i Dynamisk?
# Test C: Er stimulus-entropien forskellig mellem Statisk og Dynamisk? (Burde være nej, hvis I har designet det pænt)

# ==============================================================================
# VISUALISERING MED SIGNIFIKANS-BRACKETS
# ==============================================================================

ggplot(entropy_long, aes(x = entropy_source, y = entropy_value, fill = block_type)) +
  # Violin plot for at vise fordelingen + et indlejret boxplot for spredningen
  geom_violin(alpha = 0.5, trim = FALSE, position = position_dodge(0.8)) +
  geom_boxplot(width = 0.2, position = position_dodge(0.8), color = "black", alpha = 0.7, outlier.shape = NA) +
  
  # Farver og akser
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, max(entropy_long$entropy_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.2)) +
  
  # Engelske tekster til rapporten
  labs(
    title = "Entropy Analysis: Objective Reality vs. Subjective Prediction",
    subtitle = "Comparing Shannon entropy (in bits) across sequence types",
    x = "Source of Entropy",
    y = "Average Entropy (Bits)",
    fill = "Sequence Logic"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  # 7. Tilføj statistiske sammenligninger på plottet
  # Her tester den automatisk den Røde (Dynamic) vs. den Blå (Static) søjle inden for hver kategori
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = block_type), label = "p.format", method = "t.test", label.y = max(entropy_long$entropy_value, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05)
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# ANALYSE AF NØJAGTIGHED: KONTEKST & BLOK-TYPE
# ==========================================
library(tidyverse)

# 1. KORREKT BINARISERING OG KATEGORISERING
# Vi sikrer os at "ss" (standard) og "as" (deviant) genkendes korrekt
df_analyseret <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # 1. Binarisering (ss = 0, as = 1)
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    
    # 2. OPRET deviant_possible først (VIGTIGT)
    deviant_possible = case_when(
      as.logical(toupper(av)) == TRUE ~ "Audio-Visual (AV)",
      as.logical(toupper(sv)) == TRUE ~ "Somato-Visual (SV)",
      as.logical(toupper(as)) == TRUE ~ "Audio-Somato (AS)",
      TRUE                            ~ "None"
    ),
    
    # 3. Nu kan du bruge deviant_possible til at definere grupperne
    analysis_group = case_when(
      block_num <= 12 ~ deviant_possible, 
      block_num > 12  ~ "Mixed (SV/AS/AV)",
      TRUE            ~ "Other"
    ),
    
    is_correct = as.logical(toupper(correct))
  ) %>%
  filter(analysis_group != "Other")

# 3. STATISTISK TEST: TWO-WAY ANOVA

nøjagtighed_stats <- df_analyseret %>%
  group_by(participant_id, analysis_group, block_type) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_accuracy = mean(is_correct, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
# Vi tester om der er forskel på typerne (AS/SV/AV/Mix) og blok-typen (Statisk/Dynamisk)
model_acc <- aov(mean_accuracy ~ analysis_group * block_type, data = nøjagtighed_stats)

print("--- ANOVA RESULTATER FOR NØJAGTIGHED ---")
print(summary(model_acc))

# 4. VISUALISERING: BAR-CHART OVER PRÆSTATION
ggplot(nøjagtighed_stats, aes(x = analysis_group, y = mean_accuracy, fill = block_type)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = "dodge", alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Nøjagtighed pr. Stimuli-kontekst",
    subtitle = "Sammenligning af Statiske vs. Dynamiske trials på tværs af deviant-typer",
    x = "Kontekst / Deviant Type",
    y = "Gennemsnitlig Accuracy (%)",
    fill = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# ==========================================
# REGRESSION: ENTROPI VS. NØJAGTIGHED (RETTET)
# ==========================================

# Vi skaber regression_data og sikrer at 'correct_logical' findes
regression_data <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Sikr korrekt binarisering (ss=0, as=1)
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    # Opret den logiske kolonne til gennemsnitsberegning
    correct_logical = as.logical(toupper(correct))
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  summarise(
    block_entropy = calc_entropy(binary_state),
    accuracy = mean(correct_logical, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Nu køres plottet med alle tre regressionslinjer
ggplot(regression_data, aes(x = block_entropy, y = accuracy)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = block_type), alpha = 0.5) +
  # Linjer for Statisk og Dynamisk
  geom_smooth(aes(color = block_type, fill = block_type), 
              method = "lm", alpha = 0.2) +
  # Den samlede linje for ALT data (sort stiplet)
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "black", linetype = "dashed", 
              se = FALSE, size = 1) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Sammenhæng mellem Entropi og Nøjagtighed",
    x = "Binær Stimulus Entropi (Bits)",
    y = "Accuracy (%)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

# ==========================================
# STATISTISK TEST AF REGRESSIONSLINJER
# ==========================================

# 1. Samlet regression (Den sorte stiplede linje)
model_total <- lm(accuracy ~ block_entropy, data = regression_data)
print("--- SAMLET REGRESSION (ALLE TRIALS) ---")
summary(model_total)

# 2. Regression opdelt på Blok-type (De farvede linjer)
# Vi bruger en interaktionsmodel for at se om hældningerne er forskellige
model_split <- lm(accuracy ~ block_entropy * block_type, data = regression_data)
print("--- REGRESSION OPDELT PÅ BLOK-TYPE ---")
summary(model_split)

# install.packages("ggpubr") # Kør hvis du ikke har den
library(ggpubr)

ggplot(regression_data, aes(x = block_entropy, y = accuracy, color = block_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE) +
  # Tilføjer korrelationskoefficient (R) og p-værdi direkte i plottet
  stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..rr.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), 
           label.x = 0.1, method = "pearson") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(title = "Signifikans af hældning: Entropi vs. Accuracy") +
  theme_minimal()

# FACETTERET REGRESSION MED SIGNIFIKANS

library(tidyverse)
library(ggpubr) # Bruges til stat_cor

# 1. Forbered data (Sikr binarisering og gruppering)
regression_stats <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Binarisering (ss = 0, as = 1)
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    correct_logical = as.logical(toupper(correct)),
    
    # Kategorisering af deviants
    deviant_type = case_when(
      as.logical(toupper(av)) == TRUE ~ "AV",
      as.logical(toupper(sv)) == TRUE ~ "SV",
      as.logical(toupper(as)) == TRUE ~ "AS",
      TRUE                            ~ "None"
    ),
    analysis_group = case_when(
      block_num <= 12 ~ deviant_type,
      block_num > 12  ~ "Mixed",
      TRUE            ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(analysis_group %in% c("AS", "SV", "AV", "Mixed")) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type, analysis_group) %>%
  summarise(
    block_entropy = calc_entropy(binary_state),
    accuracy = mean(correct_logical, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Plot med signifikansniveauer
ggplot(regression_stats, aes(x = block_entropy, y = accuracy, color = block_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  
  # Regressionslinjer pr. blok-type
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, alpha = 0.1) +
  
  # TILFØJ STATISTIK: Viser R^2 og p-værdi for hver linje i hver facet
  stat_cor(aes(label = paste(..rr.label.., ..p.label.., sep = "~`,`~")), 
           label.x.npc = "left", label.y.npc = "bottom", size = 3) +
  
  # Facettering
  facet_wrap(~analysis_group, ncol = 2) +
  
  # Formatering
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Regression og Signifikans pr. Deviant-kontekst",
    subtitle = "Viser om entropiens effekt er statistisk signifikant (p < 0.05)",
    x = "Binær Stimulus Entropi (Bits)",
    y = "Accuracy (%)",
    color = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

# ==========================================

# 1. Definer tærskel og beregn lokal entropi
threshold_val <- 0.85

kæde_data <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  arrange(trial, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    local_entropy = calc_running_entropy(binary_state),
    is_above = local_entropy > threshold_val
  ) %>%
  # 2. Udtræk alle sekvenslængder (runs) pr. blok
  do({
    runs <- rle(na.omit(.$is_above))
    data.frame(
      længde = runs$lengths,
      status = ifelse(runs$values, "Over 0.85 (Ustabil)", "Under 0.85 (Stabil)")
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Beregn overblik (Median og gennemsnitlig længde)
sekvens_resumé <- kæde_data %>%
  group_by(block_type, status) %>%
  summarise(
    Gns_Længde = mean(længde),
    Median_Længde = median(længde),
    Max_Længde = max(længde),
    Antal_Sekvenser = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ==========================================
# PLOT: SEKVENSLÆNGDE VS. KORREKTHED (TÆRSKEL 0.85)
# ==========================================

threshold_val <- 0.85

# 1. Udtræk sekvenser med deres tilhørende korrekthed
sekvens_performance <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    correct_logical = as.logical(toupper(correct))
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  arrange(trial, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    local_entropy = calc_running_entropy(binary_state),
    is_above = local_entropy > threshold_val,
    # Skab et unikt ID for hver sammenhængende sekvens (run)
    run_id = with(rle(is_above), rep(seq_along(values), lengths))
  ) %>%
  # 2. Beregn længde og korrekthed pr. sekvens
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type, run_id, is_above) %>%
  summarise(
    længde = n(),
    avg_acc = mean(correct_logical, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 3. Transformér x-aksen: Under 0.85 bliver negativ, Over bliver positiv
  mutate(
    plot_x = ifelse(is_above, længde, -længde),
    status = ifelse(is_above, "Over 0.85 (Ustabil)", "Under 0.85 (Stabil)")
  )

# 4. Visualisering
ggplot(sekvens_performance, aes(x = plot_x, y = avg_acc, color = block_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.3) +
  # Tilføj en regressionslinje eller glidende gennemsnit for at se tendensen
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE) +
  # Linje ved x=0 for at adskille de to typer sekvenser
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Effekt af sekvensvarighed på korrekthed",
    subtitle = "Negative værdier = Stabil fase (<0.85 bit). Positive = Ustabil fase (>0.85 bit).",
    x = "Sekvenslængde (Trials i træk)",
    y = "Gennemsnitlig Korrekthed (%)",
    color = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# ==========================================
# AREAL-ANALYSE: KUMULATIV ENTROPI VS. ACCURACY
# ==========================================

threshold_val <- 0.85

# 1. Beregn arealer pr. sekvens
areal_performance <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1),
    correct_logical = as.logical(toupper(correct))
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  arrange(trial, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    local_entropy = calc_running_entropy(binary_state),
    is_above = local_entropy > threshold_val,
    # Identificer de sammenhængende sekvenser (runs)
    run_id = with(rle(is_above), rep(seq_along(values), lengths))
  ) %>%
  # 2. Beregn arealet for hver sekvens
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type, run_id, is_above) %>%
  summarise(
    # Arealet er summen af afvigelsen fra tærsklen
    sekvens_areal = sum(abs(local_entropy - threshold_val), na.rm = TRUE),
    avg_acc = mean(correct_logical, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # 3. Transformér x-aksen (Stabil = Negativt areal, Ustabil = Positivt areal)
  mutate(
    plot_x = ifelse(is_above, sekvens_areal, -sekvens_areal),
    status = ifelse(is_above, "Over 0.85 (Ustabil)", "Under 0.85 (Stabil)")
  )

# 4. Visualisering
ggplot(areal_performance, aes(x = plot_x, y = avg_acc, color = block_type)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.4, size = 2) +
  # Loess-linje for at fange den ikke-lineære tendens
  geom_smooth(method = "loess", se = TRUE, size = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Korrekthed som funktion af Entropisk Areal",
    subtitle = "Areal = Summen af (Entropi - 0.85). Til venstre: Stabile faser. Til højre: Ustabile faser.",
    x = "Kumulativt Areal (Afvigelse fra 0.85 tærskel)",
    y = "Gennemsnitlig Accuracy (%)",
    color = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# ==========================================
# HISTOGRAM: SEKVENSER PR. ENTROPI-BIN (0.05)
# ==========================================

# 1. Forbered data og beregn løbende entropi
histogram_data <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    binary_state = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", 0, 1)
  ) %>%
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  arrange(trial, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    local_entropy = calc_running_entropy(binary_state),
    # Vi skaber bins med trin på 0.05
    # floor(x/0.05)*0.05 placerer entropien i den korrekte 'skuffe'
    entropy_bin = floor(local_entropy / 0.05) * 0.05
  ) %>%
  # 2. Identificer sekvenser (kæder) der bliver i samme bin
  do({
    # Vi fjerner NA (typisk de første trials i en blok)
    clean_bins <- na.omit(.$entropy_bin)
    if(length(clean_bins) == 0) return(data.frame())
    
    runs <- rle(clean_bins)
    data.frame(
      bin = runs$values,
      længde = runs$lengths
    )
  }) %>%
  ungroup()

# 3. Visualisering: Antallet af sekvenser pr. interval
ggplot(histogram_data, aes(x = bin, fill = block_type)) +
  # Vi bruger geom_histogram med binwidth 0.05 og starter ved 0
  geom_histogram(binwidth = 0.05, boundary = 0, position = "dodge", alpha = 0.7) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.1), limits = c(0, 1.05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  labs(
    title = "Histogram over Entropiske Sekvenser",
    subtitle = "Antallet af sammenhængende kæder i 0.05 bins",
    x = "Entropi Niveau (0.00 til 1.00 bits)",
    y = "Antal observerede sekvenser (Frekvens)",
    fill = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# ==========================================
# ANALYSE AF STANDARD VS. DEVIANT ACCURACY
# ==========================================

# 1. Præparering af data
trial_type_analysis <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Definer om trial er Standard eller Deviant
    trial_category = ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", "Standard", "Deviant"),
    correct_logical = as.logical(toupper(correct)),
    block_type = factor(block_type, levels = c("Static", "Dynamic"))
  ) %>%
  # Gruppér for at få gennemsnit pr. deltager pr. kategori
  group_by(participant_id, block_type, trial_category) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_acc = mean(correct_logical, na.rm = TRUE),
    n = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# 2. Deskriptiv statistik (Tabel-oversigt)
summary_stats <- trial_type_analysis %>%
  group_by(block_type, trial_category) %>%
  summarise(
    avg_performance = mean(mean_acc),
    sd_performance = sd(mean_acc),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

print(summary_stats)

# 3. Visualisering: Barplot med fejl-barer
ggplot(trial_type_analysis, aes(x = trial_category, y = mean_acc, fill = block_type)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(0.9), alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Static" = "#4285F4", "Dynamic" = "#EA4335")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Korrekthed: Standard vs. Deviant Trials",
    subtitle = "Opdelt på Statiske og Dynamiske blokke (Mean +/- SE)",
    x = "Trial Kategori",
    y = "Accuracy (%)",
    fill = "Blok Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# 4. Statistisk test: Two-way ANOVA
# Tester om bloktype og trial-type påvirker hinanden (interaktion)
anova_res <- aov(mean_acc ~ block_type * trial_category, data = trial_type_analysis)
summary(anova_res)

# ==============================================================================
# FACETTERET PLOT MED PARVISE SIGNIFIKANS-SAMMENLIGNINGER (ENGELSK)
# ==============================================================================

# 1. Definer de parvise sammenligninger, du vil teste internt i hver facet (Standard vs Deviant)
# Da x-aksen er 'trial_category', sammenligner vi 'Standard' vs 'Deviant'
within_facet_comparisons <- list( c("Standard", "Deviant") )

# For at lave sammenligninger på tværs af de farvede søjler (Static vs Dynamic) 
# inden for hver trial-type, genererer vi en kombineret variabel til plottet
plot_data_significance <- trial_type_analysis_four_blocks %>%
  mutate(
    # Sikrer engelske navne på x-aksen og i sdt-kategorierne
    trial_category = factor(trial_category, levels = c("Standard", "Deviant")),
    block_type = factor(block_type, levels = c("Dynamic", "Static")),
    # Kombineret gruppe til de avancerede tests på tværs af farver
    comb_group = interaction(trial_category, block_type)
  )

# 2. Generering af det engelske plot med statistiske sammenligninger
ggplot(plot_data_significance, aes(x = trial_category, y = mean_acc, fill = block_type)) +
  # Søjler med fejl-barer (Mean +/- SE)
  stat_summary(fun = mean, geom = "bar", position = position_dodge(0.9), alpha = 0.8) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se, geom = "errorbar", position = position_dodge(0.9), width = 0.2) +
  
  # Facettering efter de 4 kontekster
  facet_wrap(~deviant_context) +
  
  # FARVESKEMA (Dine præcise farver udtrukket fra billederne)
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Static" = "blue", "Dynamic" = "red")) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(), limits = c(0, 1.15)) + 
  
  # ENGELSKE TEKSTER
  labs(
    title = "Accuracy Analysis: Standard vs. Deviant Trials Across Contexts",
    subtitle = "Pairwise comparisons of sequence type (Static vs. Dynamic) and trial types (Standard vs Deviant)",
    x = "Trial Category",
    y = "Response Accuracy (%)",
    fill = "Sequence type"
  ) +
  
  # AKADEMISK THEME
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) + # Minimal definerer gitterlinjer...
  theme(
    # ...og her fjerner vi dem fuldstændigt:
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(), 
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), 
    
    panel.spacing = unit(1.5, "lines"),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 11),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  
  # STATISTISKE COMPARISONS
  stat_compare_means(aes(group = block_type), label = "p.format", method = "t.test", hide.ns = FALSE, label.y = 1.02)
```

```{r}
# ==============================================================================
# BAYESIAN ANALYSIS: BLOCK TYPE × TRIAL CATEGORY × CONTEXT
# ==============================================================================
# Installer brms og tidybayes hvis du ikke har dem:
# install.packages("brms")
# install.packages("tidybayes")
# install.packages("emmeans")


library(brms)
library(tidybayes)
library(emmeans)


# 1. Tilpas den Bayesianske logistiske mixed-effects model
# Vi bruger her dit oprindelige trial-level data (df_clean), 
# da en binomial model fungerer bedst på de rå binære svar (0 og 1)
bayes_data <- df_clean %>%
  mutate(
    # Genberegn de nødvendige variable på trial-level
    correct_logical = as.integer(as.logical(toupper(correct))),
    trial_category = factor(ifelse(str_trim(state) == "ss", "Standard", "Deviant")),
    block_type = factor(block_type, levels = c("Static", "Dynamic"))
  ) %>%
  # Find kontekst pr. blok
  group_by(participant_id, block_num, block_type) %>%
  mutate(
    unique_deviants = list(unique(str_trim(state[state != "ss"]))),
    deviant_context = case_when(
      all(c("as", "sv", "av") %in% unlist(unique_deviants)) ~ "Mixed",
      "as" %in% unlist(unique_deviants) ~ "AS",   # RETTET HER (%in%)
      "sv" %in% unlist(unique_deviants) ~ "SV",   # RETTET HER (%in%)
      "av" %in% unlist(unique_deviants) ~ "AV",   # RETTET HER (%in%)
      TRUE ~ "Unknown"
    )
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  filter(deviant_context != "Unknown")

# Kør Bayes-modellen (Bemærk: Dette kan tage et par minutter at fitte)
bayes_model <- brm(
  formula = correct_logical ~ block_type * trial_category * deviant_context + (1 | participant_id),
  data = bayes_data,
  family = bernoulli(link = "logit"),
  prior = c(
    prior(normal(0, 1.5), class = "b"),       # Svagt informative priors for effekter
    prior(student_t(3, 0, 2.5), class = "sd") # Prior for random effects spredning
  ),
  chains = 4, iter = 2000, warmup = 1000, cores = 4,
  seed = 1234,
  file = "bayes_model_accuracy" # Gemmer modellen, så den ikke skal fittes hver gang
)

# Vis modeloverblik (Tjek Rhat-værdier; de skal være tæt på 1.00 for konvergens)
summary(bayes_model)

# ==============================================================================
# 2. UDTRÆK AF POSTERIOR CONTRASTS (DYNAMIC VS STATIC)
# ==============================================================================

# Vi bruger emmeans til at trække de specifikke kontraster ud på sandsynlighedsskalaen (back-transformed)
grid_bayes <- emmeans(bayes_model, ~ block_type | trial_category * deviant_context, type = "response")

# Beregn forskellene: Dynamic minus Static inden for hver trial_category og context
contrasts_bayes <- pairs(grid_bayes, reverse = TRUE)

print("--- POSTERIOR CONTRASTS (DYNAMIC VS STATIC DIFFERENCES) ---")
print(summary(contrasts_bayes, credible_interval = 0.95))

# ==============================================================================
# 3. VISUALISERING AF POSTERIOR FORDELINGER FOR EFFEKTERNE
# ==============================================================================
# Her plotter vi sandsynlighedsfordelingen for forskellen (Dynamic - Static)
# Hvis fordelingen ikke overlapper 0, er der en klar Bayesiansk effekt.

contrasts_bayes_draws <- gather_emmeans_draws(contrasts_bayes)

ggplot(contrasts_bayes_draws, aes(x = .value, y = deviant_context, fill = trial_category)) +
  stat_halfeye(alpha = 0.6, .width = c(0.89, 0.95)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  facet_wrap(~trial_category) +
  labs(
    title = "Posterior Distributions of the Entropy Effect (Dynamic - Static)",
    subtitle = "Values represent change in Accuracy. Points show median; thick/thin lines show 89% and 95% HDIs.",
    x = "Difference in Accuracy (Probability Scale)",
    y = "Deviant Context",
    fill = "Trial Type"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
